description: Inter-class row-wise and intra-class column-wise Pearson distance between student and fixed teacher probability matrices, weighted by beta and gamma (paper §3.1 Eqs. (6)–(8), §3.2 Eqs. (9)–(10)); callers apply softmax and temperature per §2 Eq. (2). Structured-objective bindings follow src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-50.

examples.title: Train a student with DIST correlation loss

name: Distillation Correlation (DIST)

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts only beta and gamma; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.beta: finite nonnegative real weight for inter-class loss (default 1.0)
parameters.gamma: finite nonnegative real weight for intra-class loss (default 1.0)
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because the paper defines no ignored samples or classes
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite row-normalized floating-point student probabilities shaped [B,C], B and C at least 2
parameters.reduction: none returns beta times each row distance plus gamma times the mean column distance; mean averages that vector and sum totals it (default mean)
parameters.targets: finite row-normalized floating-point fixed-teacher probabilities matching student shape, dtype, and device; detached from gradients
